newsitem.title: UK: Smiths gains after half-year profit rise.
newsitem.headline: Smiths gains after half-year profit rise.

text.p: Shares in engineering group Smiths Industries Plc were indicated higher on Wednesday after half-year pre-tax profits met with analysts expectations.
The shares were up 10p at 805-1/2p by 0721 GMT.
Smiths said first-half profit before tax and exceptional items rose 15 percent to 80.2 million stg.
Analysts had been forecasting profits of between 76-84 million stg. An interim dividend of 6.15p also fell in line with expectations.

Smiths said in a statement accompanying the results that it had benefited from an upturn in the world aerospace industry and had been less affected than some other companies by the stronger currency. "The results were solid," said Andy Chambers, industry analyst at SocGen. "A fairly confident statement and good progress in the aerospace division, which is encouraging."
Chambers noted the relatively flat performance of the Medical Systems division but said the Industrial group had performed well.
"Medical Systems was affected by translation and reduced margins on UK exports because of the currency, but I wouldn't expect there to be a negative share reaction to these results."
